summary: Iteration 56 - Security Hardening Tests. All 4 pillars verified: 1) FREK-ID uniqueness (MongoDB unique sparse index confirmed, collision-proof generation working), 2) Anti-bot barriers (rate limiting 5/hour working, disposable email blocking working, OTP cooldown 60s working), 3) Fraud prevention (suspicious IP detection working - flags 3+ registrations from same IP), 4) Future-proof design (FREK-ID format FREK-XXXX-XXXX with 36^8 = 2.8 trillion combinations).

minor.issue: Admin bypass emails are subject to rate limiting (rate limit check happens before admin bypass check). This may be intentional for security but could lock out admins if rate limit is hit.

disposable_email_blocking.yopmail.com: PASSED - Returns 400 with 'Les adresses email temporaires ne sont pas acceptees'

otp_cooldown.details: Second request for same email within 60s returns 429 with cooldown message

rate_limiting.details: 5 requests allowed per IP per hour, 6th request returns 429 'Trop de tentatives'

frek_id_format.details: Format is FREK-XXXX-XXXX with A-Z and 0-9 characters

frek_id_uniqueness.details: MongoDB unique sparse index on frek_id confirmed (unique=True, sparse=True)

suspicious_ip_detection.details: Users marked suspicious=true when 3+ auto_register events from same IP in 1 hour

admin_bypass.details: cultureconnectorg@gmail.com with code 000000 works, returns bypass=true

critical_code_review_comments: FREK-ID generation uses secrets.choice() for cryptographic randomness - good security practice
Collision check with while loop (max 20 attempts) ensures uniqueness even under high load
MongoDB unique sparse index provides database-level uniqueness guarantee
Disposable email blocklist contains 44 domains - comprehensive coverage
Rate limiting is per-IP using in-memory store - will reset on server restart
OTP cooldown is per-email using in-memory store - will reset on server restart
Suspicious IP detection queries pro_access_logs collection for auto_register events

success_rate.backend: 100% - All security features working as specified

seed_data_creation: Test users created and cleaned up via MongoDB delete operations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 56 complete. Security hardening verified: 1) FREK-ID uniqueness with MongoDB unique sparse index, 2) Rate limiting 5/hour per IP, 3) OTP cooldown 60s per email, 4) Disposable email blocking (44 domains), 5) Suspicious IP detection (3+ registrations flags user). Note: Rate limit and OTP cooldown stores are in-memory and reset on server restart. Admin bypass works but is subject to rate limiting (rate limit check happens before admin bypass check in code flow).

mocked_apis_list: Email sending (SES sandbox) - code stored in memory, retrievable via /api/pro/dev/get-code/{email}
